description.value: Sparkling Hill Resort is a luxury adults-only 4-Diamond wellness resort perched on a granite ridge overlooking Okanagan Lake near Vernon, BC, founded by the Swarovski crystal family and decorated with over 3.5 million Swarovski crystals throughout its 149 rooms. The 40,000 sq. ft. KurSpa draws on the European hot-cold-rest healing philosophy and offers over 100 treatments. Touring cyclists arriving after a long day on the Okanagan will find multiple on-site dining venues, including a fine-dining restaurant and a casual café.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active (© 2026, live booking system) and confirms the resort is a real, open luxury adults-only property. Address (888 Sparkling Place, Vernon, BC V1H 2K7) and phone (1-877-275-1556) are confirmed via the contact page; OSM carried no phone number. Neither the website nor any OSM tags mention cycling-specific amenities such as bike storage, laundry, or tools, so all those fields default to null; the exception is on-site evening dining, which is clearly evidenced by multiple named restaurants.
concerns: OSM community tag is 'Oyama' but the resort address and website consistently identify the location as Vernon, BC — OSM community tag may be incorrect.
No phone number in OSM tags; phone 1-877-275-1556 sourced from website only.
Address in OSM lacks city and postal code; full address (Vernon, BC V1H 2K7) taken from website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable luxury resort confirmed open via live website. Useful to touring cyclists as overnight accommodation with on-site dining along the Okanagan corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Adults-only property. No cycling-specific amenities confirmed or denied on the website; a direct inquiry to the resort would be needed to assess bike storage and related criteria.

Nearby evening food.detail: Multiple on-site dining outlets: PeakFine at Sparkling Hill (fine dining), Gerni's Farmhouse, Barrique & Java, and in-room dining service
